public_body: Diman Regional Vocational Technical School District Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation for the lack of public participation at the December 6, 2018 meeting and declined to review the Code of Ethics allegation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee did not allow public participation at its Dec. 6, 2018 meeting when it voted not to renew the Superintendent's contract.
allegations.key_passage: The law does not require that a public body allow public participation, but rather gives the chair of the public body discretion to decide whether to permit public comment during a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee violated its own Code of Ethics.
allegations.key_passage: The Division of Open Government’s statutory authority concerns compliance only with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
